usedFor: ActiveCampaign holds your marketing contacts; Balsio is where your team and outside participants talk in threads. A “New Contact” in ActiveCampaign can bring that person into a conversation, or queue a first message for them.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in ActiveCampaign, then “Add Users to Thread” in Balsio
bestTemplate.why: It puts a new contact straight into the right thread by email address, so the conversation exists before anyone has to set it up.

watchOut: “Add Users to Thread” works from an email address, so check that the contact arrives with one filled in. “Create Scheduled Message” also needs a thread ID.
